m: I now have the Seer's vote

resyncStep.text: Please open the quest's Quest Journal to sync your state.

talkToPeer.text: Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the Rellekka market. You will need to bank all your items. Peer will offer to do this for you.

goDownstairsWithKey.text: Open and go down the trapdoor.

useFrozenKeyOnRange.text: Use the frozen key on the cooking range.

useVaseOnTable.text: Use the filled, sealed vase on the frozen table.

fillVase.text: Use the empty vase on the tap.

useBucketOnScale.text: Use the 4/5ths full bucket on the chest with a scale on it.

useBucketOnTap2.text: Use the empty bucket on the tap.

useJugOnDrain1.text: Empty the full jug into the drain.

useJugOnDrain1RealStep.text: Empty the full jug into the drain.

useBucketOnTap1.text: Use the empty bucket on the tap.

useBucketOnTap1RealStep.text: Use the empty bucket on the tap.

searchChest2.text: Search the chest in the south of the room.

searchChest1.text: Search the chest in the south of the room.

searchCupboard2.text: Search the cupboard in the south west of the room.

searchCupboard1.text: Search the cupboard in the south west of the room.

useDiskNewOnMural.text: Use the other red disk on the abstract mural.

useDiskNewOnMuralRealStep.text: Use the other red disk on the abstract mural.

useDiskOldOnMural.text: Use the old red disk on the abstract mural.

useDiskOldOnMuralRealStep.text: Use the old red disk on the abstract mural.

useDiskAnyOnMural.text: Use the red disks on the abstract mural.

useDiskAnyOnMuralRealStep.text: Use the red disks on the abstract mural.

openTrapDoorAndGoDown1.text: Open and go down the trapdoor.

cookHerring.text: Use the red herring on the cooking range.

cookHerringRealStep.text: Use the red herring on the cooking range.

searchBookcase.text: Search the bookcase for a red herring. If you've already unlocked the mural, go search it instead.

enterPeerHouse.text: Try to enter Peer the Seer's house after banking all your items. Peer the Seer will offer to bank everything for you.

talkToSwensen.text: Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.

talkToThorvald.text: Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall.

killKoschei4.text: You must now either die (SAFE DEATH), or defeat Koschei once more. Do not leave or you'll have to fight him again.

killKoschei3.text: Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.

killKoschei2.text: Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.

killKoschei1.text: Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.

waitForKoschei.text: Wait for Koschei the Deathless to spawn. If you brought a dramen branch you should now fletch it and equip the staff.

goDownLadderToKoschei.text: When you're ready to fight Koschei, go down the ladder.

talkToSigmund.text: Talk to Sigmund the Merchant in the Rellekka market.

bringExoticFlowerToSigmund.text: Finally, bring the exotic flower to Sigmund the Merchant in the Rellekka market.

bringBalladToSailor.text: Bring the ballad to the Sailor on the docks.

bringSturdyBootsToOlaf.text: Bring the sturdy boots to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall.

bringFiscalStatementToYsra.text: Bring the fiscal statement to Ysra in her shop west of the market.

bringTrackingMapToBrundt.text: Bring the tracking map to Brundt in the longhall.

bringCustomBowStringToSigli.text: Bring the custom bow string to Sigli south of the longhall.

bringUnusualFishToSkulgrimen.text: Bring the unusual fish to Skulgrimen north of the longhall.

bringSeaFishingMapToFisherman.text: Bring the sea fishing map to the Fisherman on the pier north of the market.

bringWeatherForecastToSwensen.text: Bring the weather forecast to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.

bringWarriorsContractToPeer.text: Bring the warriors' contract to Peer the Seer south west of the market.

bringChampionsTokenToThorvald.text: Bring the champions token to Thorvald north of the longhall.

bringCocktailToManni.text: Bring the cocktail to Manni the Reveller in the longhall.

bringNoteToThora.text: Bring the promissory note to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall.

talkToAskeladdenForSigmund2.text: Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.

talkToAskeladdenForSigmund.text: Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.

talkToThoraForSigmund.text: Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall.

talkToManniForSigmund.text: Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall.

talkToThorvaldForSigmund.text: Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall.

talkToPeerForSigmund.text: Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the market.

talkToSwenesenForSigmund.text: Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.

talkToFishermanForSigmund.text: Talk to the Fisherman on the pier north of the market.

talkToSkulgrimenForSigmund.text: Talk to Skulgrimen north of the longhall.

talkToSigliForSigmund.text: Talk to Sigli south of the longhall.

talkToBrundtForSigmund.text: Talk to Brundt in the longhall.

talkToYsra.text: Talk to Ysra in her shop west of the market.

talkToOlafForSigmund.text: Talk to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall.

talkToSailor.text: Talk to the Sailor on the docks.

talkToSigli.text: Talk to Sigli south of the longhall for a hunters' talisman.

returnToSigli.text: Return the charged hunters' talisman to Sigli.

huntDraugen.text: Use the hunter's talisman to hunt down the Draugen. It'll appear near one of the butterflies in the area.

talkToManni.text: Talk to Manni the Reveller in the Rellekka longhall.

cheatInBeerDrinking.text: Talk to Manni the Reveller to cheat in the competition.

getKegOfBeer.text: Pick up a keg of beer in the longhall.

useAlcoholFreeOnKeg.text: Use the low alcohol beer on the keg of beer whilst in the longhall.

getAlcoholFreeBeer.text: Buy some alcohol free beer from the Poison Salesman in the Seer's Village pub.

useStrangeObjectOnPipe.text: Use the lit strange object on the nearby pipe!

useStrangeObject.text: Use a tinderbox on the strange object then use it on the nearby pipe.

prepareToUseStrangeObject.text: Return to Rellekka with the strange object, a tinderbox, and low alcohol beer.

getStrangeObject.text: Give the Council workman on the bridge south of Rellekka going to Seer's Village a beer.

pickUpBeer.text: Get some beer. There is beer tankard in the Rellekka longhall.

talkToOlaf.text: Talk to Olaf the Bard north east of the longhall.

performMusic.text: Return to Rellekka and enter the longhall's stage to perform. Once on stage, play the enchanted lyre.

enchantLyre.text: Bring your lyre to the Strange Altar south west of Rellekka, and use either a raw shark, raw sea turtle or raw manta ray on it.

makeLyre.text: Use the golden wool on your unstrung lyre.

spinWool.text: Spin the golden fleece into wool using a spinning wheel. The closest wheel is in Seers' Village.

fletchLyre.text: Use a knife on the branch to make an unstrung lyre

chopSwayingTree.text: Go south east of Rellekka and cut a branch from the swaying tree

talkToLaliAfterStew.text: Talk to Lalli for golden wool.

useRock.text: Use your pet rock on the stew.

usePotato.text: Use a potato on the stew.

useCabbage.text: Use a cabbage on the stew.

useOnion.text: Return to Lalli and use a onion, cabbage, potato, and pet rock on their stew. You can find the vegetables growing in the south east of Rellekka.

talkToAskeladdenForRock.text: Return to Rellekka and talk to Askeladden for a pet rock.

talkToLalli.text: Talk to Lalli to the south east of Rellekka.

talkToBrundt.text: Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.

finishQuest.text: Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall to finish the quest.
